from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStartRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single data point for a specific month from a specific report."""
    month: str = Field(description="The month the data refers to, in YYYY-MM format")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="Date the report containing this data was released, for precedence resolution")
    total_starts_value: float = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for total housing starts")
    total_starts_unit: str = Field(description="Unit scale for total starts value, e.g. 'thousands'")
    single_family_starts_value: float = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for single-family starts")
    single_family_starts_unit: str = Field(description="Unit scale for single-family starts value, e.g. 'thousands'")
    total_starts_verbatim: str = Field(description="Raw text representation of the total starts value")
    single_family_starts_verbatim: str = Field(description="Raw text representation of the single-family starts value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_data_points: list[HousingStartRecord]
